read_adapter: accepted routes from /api/tours/detail; missing geometry remains unknown

read_compatibility.equal_appointment_instants: Producer-legal equal ISO UTC instants retain their exact start/end strings and fixed state. All other appointment validation remains in the unchanged pinned canonical module.
read_compatibility.optional_geometry: Unusable optional stop coordinates become unknown non-navigable locations; route identity and order still require canonical validation.

navigation_requirements: Approved entrance evidence from the pinned authenticated Tour detail contract, exact-route complete promotion receipt, current rendered component version and authenticated user_ref. Navigation is hidden on missing, mismatched or expired evidence.

maplibre.style: ordered-stop fallback until a basemap style is configured; no paid key or external tiles

navigation_evidence.return_binding: user, session, tour, route UUID and version, projection version/digest, promotion receipt UUID/digest
